effect.fr: Tenu: Les capacités de type Acier du porteur infligent 20% de dégâts supplémentaires.
effect.en: Held: Steel-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.

flavor.en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a special metallic film that can boost the power of Steel-type moves.
